column3: MT 4:1–2; the following verses of this psalm are MT +1. NASB sets the title in braces before verse 1. Close to the Hebrew; “You have made room for me” is rendered “You have relieved me.”
“Ignominy” is rendered “a reproach,” “vanity” as “what is worthless,” and “falsehood” as “deception”; NASB repeats “How long” in the second clause.
Close to the Hebrew; “the faithful one” is rendered “the godly man.”
Close to the Hebrew; “speak in your heart” is rendered “Meditate in your heart.”
Close to the Hebrew; NASB adds “any” before “good,” and renders “face” as “countenance.”
